kjv: Ye kill, and desire to have
mine: You covet and cannot obtain, so you … murder
note: The KJV punctuation joins "ye kill" with "and desire to have", obscuring James's two parallel sequences: desire → murder, covet → fight.
TR adds "moichoi kai"; the early text (Sinaiticus*, A, B) has only the feminine "moichalides", Israel's prophetic image of an unfaithful wife.

kjv: The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy
mine: He (God) yearns jealously over the spirit that he has made to dwell in us
note: An obscure verse; SBLGNT reads "katoikisen" (he made to dwell), making God the subject who jealously longs for the spirit; the KJV makes the human spirit the subject of envious desire.
